documentTypes.title: Document types
documentTypes.description: Which Federal Register document types to return. All four by default.

publicationDateFrom.title: Published from
publicationDateFrom.description: Earliest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days ago. The archive reaches back to 1994-01-03 if you widen it.

publicationDateTo.title: Published to
publicationDateTo.description: Latest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: Agency slugs (from a federalregister.gov/agencies/<slug> URL) or full agency names — both are accepted and resolved against the official 472-agency list. Filtering by a parent agency includes its sub-agencies: "homeland-security-department" also returns Coast Guard, FEMA, CBP, TSA and USCIS documents. Leave empty for all agencies.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Full-text search across the document title and body. Leave empty to return everything matching the other filters.

significantOnly.title: Significant rules only
significantOnly.description: Only documents flagged significant under Executive Order 12866 (economically or policy significant). This flag only exists on final and proposed rules, so combining it with notices or presidential documents returns nothing.

commentsOpenOnly.title: Comment period still open
commentsOpenOnly.description: Only documents whose public comment period closes today or later — the deadline set a buyer still has time to act on. Mostly proposed rules (92% carry a comment-close date) plus about a third of notices.

cfrTitle.title: CFR title
cfrTitle.description: Filter to documents that affect this Code of Federal Regulations title, 1-50 (e.g. 40 = Protection of Environment, 21 = Food and Drugs). Verified live: narrows a 10,000-row-clamped baseline to a few hundred/year for a single title. Required if you also set CFR part.

cfrPart.title: CFR part
cfrPart.description: Filter to documents that affect this specific part within the CFR title above (e.g. "60" for 40 CFR Part 60, New Source Performance Standards). Requires cfrTitle to be set — the underlying API has no title-less part lookup and 400s on one.

order.title: Sort order
order.description: Sort by publication date, or by full-text relevance to the search query.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many documents. Deep paging is cursor-based, so there is no 10,000-row wall.
